title: Actions live-review-wake fallback crashes on any HTTP error: error handler imports src.runtime (ModuleNotFoundError: src)
roadmap_unmapped_reason: live-review pipeline incident 2026-11-25; map at planning
note: [2026-11-25 22:46Z housekeeping lane] #28927 MERGED: http_json error path puts the repo root on sys.path and falls back to a local _error doc; 2 subprocess tests (fail on old code). 404 = expected 'absent' answer from _branch_blob (contents GET at live_review_wake.py:272); the log does not print the URL. Merged, not yet observed on a live run. MEASURED: run 45709763387 (22:02Z) step Wake failed: http_json got HTTP 404 (scripts/ops/live_review_wake.py:259), then the error path ran 'from src.runtime.live_review_wake_post import _error_doc' and died ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'src' (repo root not on sys.path in Actions). Next run 45711888292 succeeded. Fix: make the error path import-safe on the runner (sys.path insert of repo root, or a local copy), plus find which URL 404'd. Owner: housekeeping lane (Manager 2026-11-25b).
